normal.text: I can't remember the first video game I played because I have been playing them my whole conscious life. We had a huge arcade in town called Space Port and also an Aladdin's Castle. I had to stand on a milk crate. I remember Frogger, Ms. Pac-Man and Q-Bert.

normal.name: Sasha's Retrobytes 🏳️‍⚧️
normal.text: *go away ;w; There's some really nice presentation flair for their first game, with pre-rendered mission hubs and some pretty solid texture mapping and polygonal graphics. And an immersive rendered cockpit. I remember picking this up cheap while catching up on DOS games with my first Win 95 PC.

heated.text: I don’t buy into the concept of a backlog. I play what I want to play, when I want to play it. I don’t guilt myself into finishing something I’m not feeling or enjoying. Pardon my language but life is too fucking short for that. But, good point, go check out some old games and avoid shitty AI slop.
